system.summary: A three-figure syllabic code the codebreaker calls 'the Venetian Cifer': each consonant takes five consecutive groups in the order a e i o u, each hundreds column a different consonant; bare vowels in row x56, single consonants in x57-x59, a few whole words whose ending is given by a superscript letter. Used in Italian letters written half in clear.

diacritics.note: A superscript letter on a word group gives the word's ending (369 with o = nostro, with a = nostra, with e = nostre).

system.sibling_key: DECODE R658 (TNA SP 106/10 f. 125), the codebreaker's own count-and-value grid of this code; used.
system.notes: Split 14 Oct 2026 from the whole-file entry: the file's system A (key R725), the second three-figure code (R722) and system C (R704, R721) are separate entries.

prior_solution.where: the contemporary English codebreaker's own partial solutions, written interlinearly on the intercepts themselves and summarised as a key on DECODE R725; no modern edition (the published SP 106 transcriptions cover only SP 106/1-4)

conditions.human_role: nothing beyond setting the target; images fetched with the project DECODE cookie

solution.what: Fetched DECODE metadata for R657, R660, R664, R704, R720, R721 and the pointers; identified the seventh record as R722 and a key record R725 in the same run of shelfmarks. Downloaded all 28 images with the project cookie.

Surveyed all 22 ciphertext pages and found they use three different systems, not one: R657 (two-figure), R660/R664/R720 (three-figure), R704/R721/R722 (letter-plus-figure). DECODE groups R720 with R704; the figures show it belongs with R660/R664.

Rebuilt about 45 values of the three-figure code (system B) by aligning the codebreaker's interlinear syllables against the groups on R664 f. 1, anchored on unambiguous words ('senza', 'della loro sicurezza', 'quelle de nuovo').

Checked the rebuilt values for consistency across lines 34-45; the apparent conflict at 252/359 resolved when 'senza' was seen to run over a line break (252 se + 359 n + 560 za), which confirms the alignment method.
Web search for any modern edition of SP 106/10; the published SP 106 transcription site covers only volumes 1-4, and nothing else was found.
Catalogue 62: fetched DECODE metadata and all 17 images of R658, R661, R663, R667, R684, R701, R702 (and R725 again) with the project cookie.

Surveyed the seven records: all are the same codebreaker's worksheets, none an intercept; R658 is his grid of the three-figure code with counts and values, R667 a count grid of a second three-figure code (system D).
Read R701 p.1 'Wordes marked with letters in the Venetian Cifer' (369 nostro, 467 questo, 430 passata) and matched it to R658's side list: the three-figure code of R664/R660 is the 'Venetian Cifer'.

Transcribed the R658 grid and rebuilt system B as a systematic syllabary (consonant x a-e-i-o-u in five rows, one consonant per hundreds column): 117 values, 102 written by the codebreaker, 15 predicted from the pattern (cat62/venetian_code.tsv).

Decoded the group strings the codebreaker glossed on R702 p.2 with the rebuilt table (cat62/check_r702.py): 46/46 groups covered, each string giving his gloss (i colonelli, della loro, sendosi, conservarsi, che possiamo prometter, in tanto).
Compared with the 2026-09-20 gloss-alignment values from R664: 260, 262, 263 and 459 were wrong (ta, ti, to, r, not mento, to, ti, v) and are corrected.

Entry split under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): sp106box10 keeps system B, the 'Venetian Cifer' of R664/R660 with the grid R658 and the glossed strings of R702 p. 2; system A (R725/R657) is now sp106r725, the second three-figure code (R722 and its worksheets) sp106r722, system C (R704/R721) sp106r704, R931 sp106r931. No new attack.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): R702 p. 2 decode saved from cat62/check_r702.py; the R664 passages and the R701 p. 1 list copied verbatim from NOTES.md into texts/; R658 and the key linked to cat62/venetian_code.tsv. Missing: no transcription or decryption of R664 in full or of R660 exists (never transcribed group by group)

Verification 3 (v3_below_b): R664, R658 and R702 were counted as read. R664_fragments.md holds two decoded phrases of an untranscribed letter (0.545 explicit holes, 98 words): decoded, not read. R658 (the code grid), R702 p. 2 (glossed worksheet strings) and R701 p. 1 (heading and word list) are not prose. No document reads: class read in part -> not read, method -> not solved, fraction_read 0.1 -> 0.
